summary.motive: Deploy maximum pass rush speed (4 defensive ends) on 3rd-and-long while setting a Cover 1 Robber trap to jump intermediate crossing and dig routes.
summary.keyDefender: SS (Robber / Lurk defender) & WDE (Speed edge rusher)
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses target the intermediate middle against man coverage expecting a void behind linebackers; the SS Robber eliminates this window while the 4-speed rush forces an early throw.
summary.failureMode: Backside slot fades or boundary double moves that take advantage of outside leverage in man coverage.

beats.title: NASCAR Front & 2-High Disguise
beats.text: Saleh unleashes the NASCAR package (4 speed rushers across the line) while showing a 2-high safety shell to disguise the Cover 1 Robber trap.

beats.title: 4-Speed Rush Blows Past Tackles
beats.text: WDE and SDE use pure edge speed from extreme Wide-9 alignments to immediately turn the corner on the offensive tackles under 1.5 seconds.

beats.title: SS Robber Jumps Intermediate Dig
beats.text: While the receivers believe they have man-to-man leverage on in-breaking routes, SS drives downhill into the robber hole directly into the primary throwing window.

beats.title: Strip Sack & Turnover Created
beats.text: With the QB’s primary read robbed and nowhere to scramble, the relentless speed rush arrives for the strip-sack turnover.

relations.tell: Pass-rush front widens into NASCAR splits and SS drops to low robber hole rather than deep 1/3
